fixed.summary: An ancestor's ground counts under a text only where its box covers the text: a hotkey placed under its slot (RpgActionBar) is over the scene and takes the tag treatment, in every style (it read 1.0–1.36:1 under the packs).

ModeSelect's unselected and locked cards and SaveLoad's unselected slots dim their art, not their words, which keep their ink; StatusGrid's expiring buff blinks its icon, not its stack count; MinimapView's north mark wears --tag-halo instead of a soft offset shadow (3.73:1 on its bezel).
A locked cell ([data-locked=true]) keeps its words' ink, as it is still read (a locked card's rules); only a disabled one takes --ink-disabled. It keeps the empty cell's shadow.

Text over glass (a backdrop: -og-material glass, backdrop-filter) is read on what the glass makes of a black and a white scene, as og-render composes it; it was read as bare text on the scene (OverlayBar's names at 1.36–1.48:1).
